arguments:
set +e
echo EXACT_REVISION
git -c safe.directory=/srv/lowcost-europa -C /srv/lowcost-europa rev-parse HEAD
echo GIT_STATUS
git -c safe.directory=/srv/lowcost-europa -C /srv/lowcost-europa status --porcelain=v1 | head -n 12
echo REPO_OWNER
stat -c '%U:%G' /srv/lowcost-europa
echo SERVICE_RECENT_RESULT
for svc in lowcost-europa.service lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.service lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.service lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.service lowcost-europa-backup.service lowcost-europa-offsite-backup.service lowcost-europa-offsite-backup-health.service; do printf '%s ' "$svc"; systemctl show "$svc" --no-pager -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ActiveState 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
echo ROUTES
for path in / /health/live/ /health/ready/ /painel/ /robots.txt /products/hifu/ /products/cavitacao-rf-vacuum-corpo/ /products/hydrodermoabrasao-aqua-facial-multifuncoes/ /products/pressoterapia-vacuum-drenagem/ /products/diodo-laser-remocao-tatuagens-pigmentacao/; do printf '%s ' "$path"; curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 6 -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n' "https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org$path"; done
echo INDEX_HEADERS
curl -sSI --max-time 6 https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org/ | grep -Ei '^(HTTP/|x-robots-tag:|strict-transport-security:|content-security-policy:)' | head -n 10
echo ROBOTS_TEXT
curl -sS --max-time 6 https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org/robots.txt | head -n 4
echo REA_VERIFY_END
